description: This file defines the AppMetada class, which represents the in-memory model of an application within the AppBuilder framework, including kernel placement, connections, and sequence management. It includes methods for completing kernel placement constraints and serializing the application model to JSON.

classes.name: AppMetada
classes.description: Represents the in-memory data structure of an application with attributes for kernels, connections, and sequence, including methods for constraint verification, kernel placement, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: __init__(self, appname, kernels, connections, sequence)
methods.description: Initializes an AppMetada instance with application name, kernels, connections, and sequence, and completes unconstrained placement.

methods.name: _complete_unconstrained_spec(self)
methods.description: Verifies constraints and assigns locations to unconstrained kernels, raising errors if placement is impossible.

methods.name: _verify_constrained_cttiles(self, ct_tiles)
methods.description: Checks that kernels constrained to specific tiles are correctly placed within those tiles.

methods.name: _place_unconstrainted_kernels(self, ct_tiles)
methods.description: Assigns locations to kernels without specified positions, ensuring no conflicts.

methods.name: to_json(self)
methods.description: Serializes the entire application model, including kernels, connections, and sequence, into a structured JSON object.
